fact: The Bank of Zambia's page says the National Payment Systems Act was enacted by parliament on 12 April 2007 to give legal backing to the operation of payment mechanisms in Zambia and to empower the Bank to regulate them.

The Bank of Zambia issued binding directives on 14 September 2024 on charges and fees for electronic money services, with penalties for Electronic Money Institutions that violate them, Zambia Monitor reports.

fact: The Bank of Zambia's 2024 e-money charges directives, issued under the National Payment Systems Act 2007 and the Bank of Zambia Act 2022 and binding on all e-money institutions, banks and financial institutions from 2 August 2024, set prohibited and capped e-money fees.
